title: Ukwethembana Kokuqala Kwaphulwa EPharadesi
intro: Cabanga umi ensimini yokuthula okuphelele, uhlonishwe ngaphezu kwayo yonke indalo, unomngcele owodwa kuphela wokuhlonipha. Ukuhleba kuthembisa ubuphakade, ukukhetha okukodwa kushintsha konke, kodwa isihe sivula indlela yokubuyela emuva. Ngubani okhuluma kusukela ekuqaleni kwesintu?
clues: Ngadalwa ngu-Allah ngobumba futhi ngabunjwa ngokunakekela kwaphezulu.
Ngadunyiswa lapho u-Allah eyala izingelosi ukuba zingikhothamele.
Ngahlala ePharadesi nomkami, ngikhululekile ukujabulela konke ngaphandle komuthi owodwa.
Ngakhohliswa ukuhleba kukaSathane owafunga ukuthi uzoba umeluleki oqotho.
Ngadla emthini owenqatshelwe futhi isembozo sami sasuswa ngenxa yehlazo.
Ngafunda amazwi okuphenduka eNkosini yami, futhi u-Allah waphendukela kimi ngesihe.

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Wenqaba ukungena eZweni Elingcwele ngenxa yokwesaba
Wadla emthini owenqatshelwe ngemva kokuhleba kukaSathane
Baphikisana ngokuthi izithombe zokhokho kumele zikhonzwe
trial.answer: Wadla emthini owenqatshelwe ngemva kokuhleba kukaSathane

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: U-Allah wangifundisa amazwi okuphenduka futhi wangithethelela
Ngashaywa umbani ngenxa yokufuna ukubona u-Allah
Ngaguqulwa nabantu bakithi ngenxa yokwephula iSabatha
outcome.answer: U-Allah wangifundisa amazwi okuphenduka futhi wangithethelela

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
